ADC.description: Adds a value from memory and the *carry flag* to the *accumulator*. This is used for multi-byte addition.
ADC.note: The *carry flag* should be cleared with **`clc`** before adding the first byte in a sequence.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.V: Set if a *signed overflow* occurs, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set if an *unsigned overflow* occurs, cleared otherwise.

AND.description: Performs a bitwise AND on the *accumulator* with a value from memory.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

ASL.description: Shifts all bits of the target operand one position to the left. This is equivalent to multiplying by 2.
ASL.note: Performs a dummy write of the original value before the final write. This can cause side effects on hardware registers.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set to the value of the original bit 7.

BCC.description: Branches if the **C** flag is clear (**C**=0). Also known as branch if less than (BLT).

BCS.description: Branches if the **C** flag is set (**C**=1). Also known as branch if greater than or equal (BGE).

BEQ.description: Branches if the **Z** flag is set (**Z**=1).

BIT.description: Performs a bitwise AND with the *accumulator* to set flags, but does not store the result. Also copies bits 7 and 6 of the memory value into the **N** and **V** flags.

flagChanges.N: Set to the value of bit 7 of the tested memory location.
flagChanges.V: Set to the value of bit 6 of the tested memory location.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the bitwise AND result is 0, cleared otherwise.

BMI.description: Branches if the **N** flag is set (**N**=1).

BNE.description: Branches if the **Z** flag is clear (**Z**=0).

BPL.description: Branches if the **N** flag is clear (**N**=0).

BRK.description: Forces a software interrupt, pushing the *program counter* and *status register* to the stack before jumping to the IRQ handler address (`$FFFE`).
BRK.warning: A simultaneous NMI (Non-Maskable Interrupt) will override this instruction, causing the intended interrupt handler to be skipped.

flagChanges.B: Set in the *status register* byte pushed to the stack.

BVC.description: Branches if the **V** flag is clear (**V**=0).

BVS.description: Branches if the **V** flag is set (**V**=1).

CLD.description: Clears the **D** flag, disabling Binary Coded Decimal (BCD) mode for arithmetic instructions.

CLI.description: Clears the **I** flag, allowing the CPU to respond to hardware interrupts (IRQs).
CLI.note: The change to the **I** flag is delayed by one instruction.

CMP.description: Compares the *accumulator* with a value from memory. This is done by subtraction, but the result is not stored. It only affects flags.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the subtraction result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the *accumulator* is equal to the memory value, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set if the *accumulator* is greater than or equal to the memory value (unsigned), cleared otherwise.

CPX.description: Compares the *X register* with a value from memory. This is done by subtraction, but the result is not stored. It only affects flags.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the subtraction result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the *X register* is equal to the memory value, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set if the *X register* is greater than or equal to the memory value (unsigned), cleared otherwise.

CPY.description: Compares the *Y register* with a value from memory. This is done by subtraction, but the result is not stored. It only affects flags.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the subtraction result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the *Y register* is equal to the memory value, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set if the *Y register* is greater than or equal to the memory value (unsigned), cleared otherwise.

DEC.description: Subtracts one from a value in memory.
DEC.note: Performs a dummy write of the original value before the final write. This can cause side effects on hardware registers.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

EOR.description: Performs a bitwise XOR on the *accumulator* with a value from memory. This is commonly used to flip specific bits.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

INC.description: Adds one to a value in memory.
INC.note: Performs a dummy write of the original value before the final write. This can cause side effects on hardware registers.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

JMP.description: Sets the *program counter* to a new address, causing execution to continue from that location.
JMP.warning: When using *indirect mode*, if the low byte of the jump vector is `$FF`, the high byte is incorrectly fetched from the start of the same page instead of the next one.

JSR.description: Pushes the return address to the stack, then jumps to a new address.
JSR.note: Pushes the address of the final byte of the instruction. **`rts`** increments this value before returning.

LDA.description: Loads a byte from memory into the *accumulator*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the loaded value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the loaded value is 0, cleared otherwise.

LDX.description: Loads a byte from memory into the *X register*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the loaded value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the loaded value is 0, cleared otherwise.

LDY.description: Loads a byte from memory into the *Y register*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the loaded value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the loaded value is 0, cleared otherwise.

LSR.description: Shifts all bits of the target operand one position to the right. Bit 7 is loaded with 0. This is equivalent to an *unsigned division* by 2.
LSR.note: Performs a dummy write of the original value before the final write. This can cause side effects on hardware registers.

flagChanges.N: Cleared.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set to the value of the original bit 0.

NOP.description: Performs no operation, consuming only cycles and program space.

ORA.description: Performs a bitwise OR on the *accumulator* with a value from memory.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

PHA.description: Pushes the current value of the *accumulator* onto the stack.

PHP.description: Pushes the current *processor status* flags onto the stack.

PLA.description: Pulls a byte from the stack into the *accumulator*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the pulled value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the pulled value is 0, cleared otherwise.

PLP.description: Pulls a byte from the stack into the *processor status register*.
PLP.note: The **B** flag from the stack is ignored. The change to the **I** flag is delayed by one instruction.

flagChanges.N: Set from bit 7 of the pulled value.
flagChanges.V: Set from bit 6 of the pulled value.
flagChanges.D: Set from bit 3 of the pulled value.
flagChanges.I: Set from bit 2 of the pulled value.
flagChanges.Z: Set from bit 1 of the pulled value.
flagChanges.C: Set from bit 0 of the pulled value.

ROL.description: Rotates all bits of the target operand one position to the left. The **C** flag is moved into bit 0, and the original bit 7 is moved into the **C** flag.
ROL.note: Performs a dummy write of the original value before the final write. This can cause side effects on hardware registers.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set to the value of the original bit 7.

ROR.description: Rotates all bits of the target operand one position to the right. The **C** flag is moved into bit 7, and the original bit 0 is moved into the **C** flag.
ROR.note: Performs a dummy write of the original value before the final write. This can cause side effects on hardware registers.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set to the value of the original bit 0.

RTI.description: Returns from an interrupt routine. Pulls the *processor status* and the *program counter* from the stack.
RTI.note: Unlike **`plp`**, **`cli`**, or **`sei`**, the effect of restoring the **I** flag is immediate.

flagChanges.N: Set from bit 7 of the value pulled from the stack.
flagChanges.V: Set from bit 6 of the value pulled from the stack.
flagChanges.D: Set from bit 3 of the value pulled from the stack.
flagChanges.I: Set from bit 2 of the value pulled from the stack.
flagChanges.Z: Set from bit 1 of the value pulled from the stack.
flagChanges.C: Set from bit 0 of the value pulled from the stack.

RTS.description: Returns from a subroutine. Pulls a return address from the stack and jumps to it.
RTS.note: Pulls an address from the stack and increments it before setting the *program counter*.

SBC.description: Subtracts a value from memory and the inverted *carry flag* from the *accumulator*. Used for multi-byte subtraction.
SBC.note: The *carry flag* should be set with **`sec`** before subtracting the first byte in a sequence.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.V: Set if a *signed overflow* occurs, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.C: Set if no borrow was required, cleared otherwise.

SED.description: Sets the **D** flag, enabling Binary Coded Decimal (BCD) mode for arithmetic instructions.

SEI.description: Sets the **I** flag, preventing the CPU from responding to hardware interrupts (IRQs).
SEI.note: The change to the **I** flag is delayed by one instruction.

STA.description: Stores the value of the *accumulator* into memory.

STX.description: Stores the value of the *X register* into memory.

STY.description: Stores the value of the *Y register* into memory.

TAX.description: Copies the value from the *accumulator* to the *X register*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the value is 0, cleared otherwise.

TAY.description: Copies the value from the *accumulator* to the *Y register*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the value is 0, cleared otherwise.

TSX.description: Copies the value from the *stack pointer* to the *X register*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the value is 0, cleared otherwise.

TXA.description: Copies the value from the *X register* to the *accumulator*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the value is 0, cleared otherwise.

TXS.description: Copies the value from the *X register* to the *stack pointer*.

TYA.description: Copies the value from the *Y register* to the *accumulator*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the value is 0, cleared otherwise.
